title: +DESIGN ENGINEERING AND PROBLEM SOLVING
description: Explores the science of design and Design Thinking, including vetted ways of approaching and defining design problems, assessing stakeholder needs, ideation and concept generation, and prototyping and experimental design. Gives students experience conducting work in teams of engineering designers to solve complex, real-world engineering problems. Introduces methods to assess problem-solving skills and assumptions, and employ computational thinking. Reinforces core mathematics and science knowledge, while emphasizing advanced professional and communication skills in an engineering design team setting.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ENGR 110*, 110H*, 310*, CORE 100*, 300*, BA 100*, 300*, ED 100*, 300*, LA 100*, 300*, SCI 100*, 300* or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student'.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in ENGR 110, ENGR 110H, ENGR 310, CORE 100, CORE 300, BA 100, BA 300, ED 100, ED 300, LA 100, LA 300, SCI 100 and SCI 300.
